fields.why: This is four case reports plus a descriptive tabulation of 97 surveillance cases. TESS and non-TESS characteristics are listed in turn but never contrasted, and the age/sex/state match is a duplicate check, so the series only describes its cases.

The claims rest on proportions (organ systems involved, % work-related), and the 54 and 43 totals mainly serve as denominators. Case counts by reporting state agency (CDPR 32, MDA 4, ...) can also be read as counts by place without a denominator, which would make count/rate defensible.

brief_issues: Only record A was provided, so B's justification was not rated. The brief does not say whether a breakdown of a series' cases by reporting source or state is 'event counts per place' (count/rate) or composition of the case total.
